# AnswerLoops

> AnswerLoops is AI support that lives in your community. It turns a stream of community support questions (Discord, Slack, forums, GitHub, Telegram, email, website chat) into a self-improving knowledge base that answers repeat questions automatically — and only when it's confident enough to be right — escalating the long tail to a human.

## What it does

A community member asks a question. AnswerLoops classifies it, searches the org's knowledge base and past resolved tickets for a matching answer, drafts a grounded response, and grades that response's confidence. High-confidence answers post automatically. Low-confidence answers route to a human support queue with an AI-drafted reply ready to edit. Every resolved answer feeds back into the knowledge base, so the same question gets cheaper and faster to answer next time.

## Who it's for

Teams whose users ask for help in a chat community instead of a support ticket: software and dev-tool companies, open-source projects, online-course creators running a paid community, game studios with a player Discord, and crypto/DAO projects. They get the same repeat questions across Discord, Slack, a forum, GitHub Issues/Discussions, Telegram, email, or their own website — and want an AI layer that answers correctly instead of hallucinating, with humans only touching the questions the AI isn't sure about.

It's not for teams running a traditional help desk like Zendesk, online stores doing email-based order support, or large enterprises buying an autonomous-agent platform.

## Core capabilities

- **Confidence-gated auto-answer** — a second AI pass grades every drafted answer before it goes out; only answers that clear the bar post automatically, everything else queues for human review
- **Multi-channel ingest** — Discord, Slack, Discourse and Circle forums, GitHub Issues/Discussions, Telegram, email, and an embeddable website chat widget, all through one pipeline (Google Chat also supported)
- **Self-improving knowledge base** — resolved tickets promote into a searchable KB; content also imports from a docs-site crawl, file upload, a GitHub repo sync, or a Notion workspace; community 👍/👎 feedback prunes bad answers over time
- **Bring your own LLM** — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, Mistral, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (including local models via Ollama); each org configures its own key and cost
- **Agent-first API access** — an MCP server (`POST /api/mcp`, JSON-RPC 2.0) lets AI agents (Claude, Cursor, custom bots) call `search_kb`, `get_faq`, `get_tickets`, `create_ticket`, and `generate_answer` directly against an org's data, authenticated with a per-org API key
- **Self-hostable** — AGPL-3.0 licensed; `docker compose up` runs the full stack on your own infrastructure with no data leaving your servers
- **Analytics** — deflection rate, hours saved, per-category accuracy, SLA attainment, all computed from real ticket data

## Pricing

Self-hosted: free forever (AGPL-3.0). Hosted (managed SaaS), billed monthly: Standard $49/mo (500 deflections, hard cap), Pro $149/mo (3,000 deflections, then $5 per 100 over), Enterprise $499/mo (unlimited) — all with a 14-day free trial, tiered by monthly deflection volume. Billed annually, each tier is 20% cheaper per month (Standard $39/mo, Pro $119/mo, Enterprise $399/mo), charged as one annual total. The pricing page defaults to the annual toggle, so $39/mo is what a first-time visitor sees for Standard; $49/mo is the same plan billed monthly.
